experiment: E13-B2 Bank Sensitivity + Extended Stability Sweep
stage: stability validation / confound diagnosis (NOT tuning, NOT a new method)
thesis_served: 确认 R1 的 paired 正收益在不同 normal-bank sampling 下是否稳定，区分方法失效 vs baseline bank sensitivity
why_now: E13-B 8/9 cells 为正但 Cube seed1 唯一负例，且 frozen R0 随 bank seed 明显漂移；必须区分方法失效与 bank sensitivity

exit.STABLE: 自动进入 Stage B，最终可恢复 PASS-like -> E13-C
exit.BORDERLINE: 仍进入 Stage B，最终 verdict 标记 HOLD-risk
exit.UNSTABLE: 不跑 Stage B，直接停止写 memo

frozen_method.candidate: R1 Linear Residual Adapter (z' = z + W z, 768->768)

staging.stage_a: Cube x seed3-7 (5 cells), then decide STABLE/BORDERLINE/UNSTABLE
staging.stage_b: Bird/Car x seed3-7 (10 cells) if not UNSTABLE
staging.total_matrix: 3 categories x 8 seeds = 24 paired cells (9 existing + 15 new)

stage_a_criteria.STABLE: Cube 8-seed mean dAUROC >= +0.005 AND positive seeds >= 6/8 AND mean dAP >= 0
stage_a_criteria.BORDERLINE: Cube mean dAUROC >= 0 AND positive seeds >= 4/8
stage_a_criteria.UNSTABLE: Cube mean dAUROC < 0 OR positive seeds <= 3/8

final_criteria.PASS_LIKE: overall mean dAUROC >= +0.010 AND positive cells >= 19/24 AND per-category 8-seed mean dAUROC >= +0.005 AND overall mean dAP >= +0.005 AND no collapse
final_criteria.HOLD: overall mean dAUROC >= +0.0075 AND positive cells >= 17/24 AND per-category mean >= 0 AND overall mean dAP >= 0
